Score patches from the downloaded inputs (calculate module)

Source: R/fn_calculate.R
rank_calculate.Rd

The calculation half of the patch ranking: given the data acquired by rank_download plus the on-disk surfaces, it computes every RankIndex term, samples the raster terms at the patch centroids, and combines them with rank_index. No network calls - it reads the files the download module wrote, so it is fast to re-run while tuning weights.

Usage

rank_calculate(
  patches,
  occ,
  suitability,
  records = NULL,
  network = NULL,
  origin = NULL,
  dem = NULL,
  resistance = NULL,
  agg = 10,
  area_col = "acres",
  prob_col = "prob_mean",
  sigma = 100,
  target_area = 50,
  cap_q = 0.95,
  k = 3,
  w_habitat = 5,
  cores = 1,
  speeds = osm_speeds,
  cluster_eps_km = NULL,
  cluster_buffer_m = 1500,
  weights = NULL
)

Arguments

patches

sf units to score (polygons or points); must carry area_col for C.

occ

known-population points (sf/SpatVector) - the sources for Dg and Dr.

suitability

habitat-suitability SpatRaster (or path): the template for the raster terms and, inverted, the dispersal resistance.

records

GBIF sf with speciesKey (and basisOfRecord) for S; NULL skips it.

network, origin

OSM road/trail sf and the trip origin for A/ C; NULL skips them.

dem

optional elevation SpatRaster for the accessibility off-trail hop.

resistance

optional precomputed friction SpatRaster for Dr; NULL builds one from inverted suitability (build_resistance).

agg

integer factor to coarsen suitability by before the raster terms (default 10); the ranking is sampled at centroids, so fine resolution is wasted here.

area_col

patch-area column (acres) used by C (default "acres").

prob_col

patch column holding the model suitability to enter as a term P (default "prob_mean"); a more-suitable patch is likelier real habitat. NULL omits it.

sigma, target_area, k, w_habitat, speeds

term parameters passed through to survey_surface / complementarity / accessibility / build_resistance.

cap_q

upper quantile at which C's raw assembly cost is clamped before the global rescale (default 0.95; passed to complementarity). NULL disables the cap. See complementarity for why the tail is clamped.

cores

fork workers for C's per-patch distance loop (default 1); passed to complementarity.

cluster_eps_km

if set, compute A/C per spatial cluster (bbox) rather than on one domain-wide graph: patches within this distance (km) share a cluster (cluster_patches), and each cluster is routed on its own small graph - all roads (for the drive-in) plus only that cluster's trails. NULL (default) uses a single graph. The per-cluster split is a big win when patches are scattered; raw travel times are rescaled once, globally, so clusters stay comparable. Cross-cluster co-visitation is negligible at this separation.

cluster_buffer_m

buffer (m) around each cluster's bbox when selecting its local trails (default 1500).

weights

per-term multipliers for rank_index (default equal).

Value

patches with the rescaled term columns, index and rank appended (an sf).

Details

Terms are computed only when their inputs are supplied, so the ranking degrades gracefully: omit records to drop S, omit network/origin to drop A/C. Dg/Dr need only occ and suitability.

See also

rank_download, rank_index
